svg.title: Indexing Theory and Vector Search: Skip Scan, BM25, R-Tree/BKD, IVF vs HNSW, and Product Quantization
svg.desc: Animated five-panel technical diagram covering Composite B-Tree Skip Scan across low-cardinality prefixes, Okapi BM25 term-frequency saturation curve, R-Tree Minimum Bounding Rectangles versus BKD-Tree partitions, IVF Voronoi nprobe cell scanning versus HNSW multi-layer greedy hop routing, and Product Quantization (PQ/SQ8) subspace codebooks with Asymmetric Distance Computation.
